name: Kiro changelog
title: IDE: Remote SSH, Dev Containers, and Cloud Sessions in the IDE
headline: Kiro IDE adds Remote SSH, Dev Containers and cloud sessions
lede: You can work in Kiro IDE against your own Linux machine over SSH, inside a project's Dev Container, or in a cloud session in its own window.

effects.effect: Agentic IDEs reach remote and containerized dev environments
Teams can keep agent work on controlled machines

possibilities.title: Kiro Enterprise shops can trial whole-codebase test generation inside admin-set sandboxes

with.title: GPT 6.2 Astra Preview rolls out to Kiro Enterprise
Kiro lets admins enforce local sandboxing

possibilities.connection: GPT 6.2 Astra Preview brings a 1M context window for multistep coding and testing to Kiro Enterprise, and Kiro's admin-enforced local sandboxing plus Dev Containers give the commands it runs organization-set file and network limits on real team setups.

possibilities.title: Platform teams can hand KV cache tuning to the agent that ranks best

with.title: InferenceBench ranks agents at building faster inference servers
AWS agent skill sets up distributed KV caching

possibilities.connection: InferenceBench ranks coding agents on how much they speed up an LLM server in two hours, the AWS skill lets a coding agent evaluate and set up distributed KV caching, and Kiro now works directly on a team's own Linux machine over SSH or in a Dev Container.
